contests.title: Central Falls city — Question 6: Lifetime limit for mayoral service

provenance.quote: Shall section 3-400 of the Charter be amended to remove the consecutive-service loophole that currently permits unlimited lifetime service by allowing a Mayor to serve 8 years, sit out a term, and run again indefinitely, and instead establish a 12-year lifetime limit for service as Mayor?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replace the mayor’s eight-year consecutive-service rule, which allows returning after sitting out a term, with a lifetime maximum of 12 years as mayor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve a 12-year lifetime limit on service as mayor.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the current consecutive-service rule allowing a later return.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replace the City Council’s eight-year consecutive-service rule, which allows returning after sitting out a term, with a lifetime maximum of 12 years as a council member.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve a 12-year lifetime limit on service as a City Council member.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the current consecutive-service rule allowing a later return.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Clarify that every elected and appointed city officer must follow all applicable city and state ethics laws. Revise the related charter enforcement and penalty provisions and remove ambiguous wording.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve that ethics-law clarification and the related enforcement and penalty updates.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed charter revision; applicable ethics laws would still govern.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Provide that the mayor appoints the police chief and fire chief with approval from a majority of City Council members.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve that appointment process for both chiefs.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed charter appointment rule.
